### Biography
Molly is a Postdoctoral Research Associate in Medical Statistics in the Division of Informatics, Imaging and Data Science at the University of Manchester. Molly recently graduated with a PhD from the University of Leicester which focused on methods to improve the estimation of cancer survival, particularly in the presence of competing risks. Molly is a former NIHR pre-doctoral fellow from the University of Leicester with a MSc in Medical Statistics with specialisation in health technology assessments. Molly’s research interests are in the fairness of clinical prediction models, as well as causal inference and survival analysis methods.
